query: Company demands 2 Lakhs because I left in 6 months. I only had orientation training.
expert_audit_response: Unenforceable penalty. Under Section 74 of the Indian Contract Act, 1872, an employer can only recover 'actual' documented costs of specialized training. Standard orientation does not qualify. Without invoices for certifications or third-party trainers, the bond is [LEGALLY VOID].

query: HR says they won't accept my resignation because it's 'mid-semester' and I must stay.
expert_audit_response: Illegal. Under Section 14 of the Specific Relief Act, 1963, contracts of personal service cannot be specifically enforced. An employer cannot force you to work against your will. Resignation is a unilateral right; 'acceptance' is a corporate myth with no statutory basis.

query: Manager removed my access and told me to sit idle until I resign 'voluntarily'.
expert_audit_response: Non-Compliant. This constitutes 'Constructive Dismissal,' which is legally retrenchment under Section 2(oo) of the Industrial Disputes Act, 1947. This triggers mandatory notice pay and retrenchment compensation under Section 25F.

query: HR deducted 20k from my salary for 'Low Performance' without any prior warning.
expert_audit_response: Statutory Violation. The Payment of Wages Act, 1936 (Section 7) and the Code on Wages, 2019 (Section 18) provide an exhaustive list of allowed deductions. 'Performance penalties' are not listed. Any such deduction requires a prior show-cause notice.

query: Hired as a Dev, but now doing 12-hour support shifts and client calls without extra pay.
expert_audit_response: Breach of Contract. Under Section 62 of the Indian Contract Act, 1872, any material change to the 'Service Conditions' (Novation) requires mutual written consent. Forcing extra-contractual duties without pay revision is a breach of the original offer letter.

query: I've been on probation for 15 months. They keep extending it every 3 months.
expert_audit_response: Unfair Labour Practice. Under the Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act, 1946, probation is typically capped at 6 months. Repeated extensions to avoid confirmation-linked benefits (PF/Bonus) are illegal under the Fifth Schedule of the ID Act.

query: My contract allows a 60-day buyout, but HR is refusing the money and forcing me to stay.
expert_audit_response: Contractual Breach. If the contract stipulates a 'pay-in-lieu' option, the employer's refusal is a violation. Physically forcing service is 'Forced Labour' under Article 23 of the Constitution. Their remedy is limited to financial damages, not physical restraint.
primary_statute: Constitution of India (Article 23) / Specific Relief Act

query: HR says they will only give my Relieving Letter if I sign a document saying I won't join competitors.
expert_audit_response: Illegal Coercion. A Relieving Letter is a factual record of service, not a bargaining chip. Forcing a post-employment non-compete is void under Section 27 of the Contract Act. Withholding service records is an Unfair Labour Practice.

query: My VP uses abusive language and threatened to 'end my career' in front of the whole team.
expert_audit_response: Non-Compliant. Model Standing Orders under the Industrial Employment Act classify 'riotous/disorderly behavior' as misconduct. You are entitled to a formal grievance redressal committee under Section 9C of the Industrial Disputes Act, regardless of gender.

query: I was terminated at 11 PM via a WhatsApp message saying 'Don't come tomorrow'.
expert_audit_response: Void Ab Initio. Termination without a written show-cause notice or a domestic inquiry violates the Principles of Natural Justice. Under Section 25F of the ID Act, retrenchment requires 1 month notice and written reasons.
